metadata.generator: CodeGraph 1.6.0 on an isolated byte-identical source snapshot; no old output baselines indexed
limitations: Includes tests, generated type bindings and P0 experiments; counts are not production complexity scores
Shell, PowerShell, Cargo/Tauri configs, docs, licenses and binary assets are exported as source but do not all have AST nodes
Cross-file symbol resolution and dynamic dispatch are best-effort; an edge is not a proof of runtime reachability

Parent working-tree CodeGraph excludes accounts/legacy.rs because the legacy accounts/ gitignore pattern matches it. This independent snapshot index includes all 77 Rust files. Original gitignore bytes are restored after indexing.
